title: 555 timer burns out above its supply rating or when its output carries more than its rated current

implements.text: The timer latches burnt when the voltage between its supply pins passes the absolute maximum, or when its output carries more than the maximum output current for 100 ms

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history and ageing; only the thresholds and the dwell are checked

parameterSources.note: absolute maximum ratings, IO, either direction
no source; chosen so the inrush into a capacitor behind the output does not burn the part

validation.dataset: src/sim/analog/live-health.test.ts: an op-amp and a 555 in the live solver

operatingRange.evidence: twice the 18 V supply rating of the NE555
twice the 225 mA output rating of the NE555

knownFailureCases: The 100 ms dwell has no source
